agregados.network_totals_def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bfr_municipal_network_totals()
 RETURNS TABLE(schools integer, students integer, classes integer, municipalities integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.bfr_municipal_school_stats),
         (SELECT coalesce(sum(students_total), 0)::int FROM public.bfr_municipal_school_stats),
         (SELECT coalesce(sum(classes_total), 0)::int FROM public.bfr_municipal_school_stats),
         (SELECT count(DISTINCT municipality_id)::int FROM public.bfr_municipal_school_stats
           WHERE municipality_id IS NOT NULL);
$function$
agregados.school_stats_viewdef:
SELECT id AS school_id,
    name AS school_name,
    city,
    zone,
    operating_status,
    municipality_id,
    ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
           FROM students st
          WHERE st.school_id = s.id) AS students_total,
    ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
           FROM classes cl
          WHERE cl.school_id = s.id) AS classes_total,
    ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS count
           FROM bfr_school_key_map m
             JOIN staff_schools ss ON ss.school_id = m.sports_school_id
          WHERE m.school_id = s.id) AS staff_links_total
   FROM schools s
  WHERE bfr_school_in_municipal_scope(id) OR bfr_is_platform_admin();
